Apple has published the YouTube livestream link for next week’s WWDC keynote and is teasing a new ‘All systems glow’ tagline.

New WWDC tagline arrives as YouTube link goes live ahead of keynote

We’re one week out from WWDC 2026’s kickoff, and Apple has shared a variety of related updates today.

The company debuted a downloadable WWDC wallpaper for iPhone, iPad, and Mac alongside an official Apple Music playlist.

Additionally, ‘All systems glow’ is the new tagline for the conference, as highlighted on Apple’s website here. Per Mark Gurman, the glowing design and tagline reference Siri’s new animation in iOS 27.

The company has also shared the YouTube livestream link for the WWDC keynote.

You’ll be able to watch via the following embed:

In addition to YouTube, Apple will also stream its WWDC keynote on its website and in the Apple TV app. You can read more about how to watch here.

The WWDC keynote kicks off at 1:00 p.m. ET on Monday, June 8. Apple will unveil iOS 27, its major Siri overhaul, macOS 27, and a lot more.

We’ll have full coverage of all of Apple’s announcements here on 9to5Mac.

What announcements are you most hoping to see at WWDC next week? Let us know in the comments.
